name: Live Scores
author: KrakenEyes
description: Live scores, schedules, and standings for soccer, hockey, basketball, football, baseball, golf, motorsport, and combat sports, with notifications.

barWidget.description: Live scores for your followed leagues and teams, with today's schedule and standings.

schema.label: Idle refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often ESPN is polled for followed leagues with a match today but nothing live right now.

schema.label: Live match refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often ESPN is polled while at least one followed match is actually in progress — kept low so goals show up fast.

schema.label: Show score in the bar
schema.description: Shows the score of the most relevant followed live match next to the icon.

schema.label: Name for soccer/football
schema.description: "Soccer" vs "Football" is a regional naming split, not a translation — pick which one this plugin uses.

schema.label: Panel header icon
schema.description: Trophy icon, or a live score / countdown widget you can click to expand.
